title: Juicy Crumbly Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: Fresh and crumbly Syrian dish featuring a Cajun and mother-sauce-base, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal option, this recipe brings a nostalgic twist to traditional kebabs.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, cajun seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or quinoa.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
